svg.title: Starfall character and environmental prop scale reference
svg.desc: Technical authoring guide. Native rectangles exported from LandingGeometry; colored composition recommendations are not native acceptance evidence.
svg.text: Use the actual star cast as your scale reference
Sunny's original packaged body is embedded unchanged. This technical plate resizes only its displayed copy.
Nominal body widths: normal 0.70 cell · grown 0.86 cell. Texture padding and animation are not body size.
Normal · 0.70 cell
Grown · 0.86 cell
A star is a scale anchor, not a prop-size ceiling.
Let large structures establish a place; repeat smaller
details to give it craft, depth and a sense of habitation.
Below, 1 normal-star body width = 80 diagram px.
Suggested starting bands for environmental props
Detail
0.5–1 star
Small lamps, flowers, trim and fittings
Secondary
2–3 stars
Benches, planters, gates and small platforms
Hero
4–6 stars
The identifying structure or restoration feature
Recommendations, not hard quotas: a bridge, tree canopy or terrace can exceed the hero band when composition calls for it.
Judge visual hierarchy at real native scale. Preserve silhouettes, touch readability and the completion landmark through every stage.
